text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Lymph Node from Colon Cancer. Given your history of colon cancer and the presence of a neck mass with normal thyroid function, the most likely diagnosis is metastatic lymphadenopathy. I recommend a fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the lymph node for cytological confirmation.
